title: Softmax and LayerNorm: resources, timing and accuracy
status: HPS measured; fabric RTL projected at 75 MHz
description: Results transcribed from the supplied comparison table. Softmax uses a 49-key row; LayerNorm uses a 192-channel token. HPS times are measured; fabric times are projected from RTL cycles at 75 MHz, not measured board latency. The 10-image results are a small local test: Softmax reports agreement with FP32; LayerNorm reports accuracy against image labels. Original table: /files/data/softmax-layernorm-results-2026-11-25.png
